mapper.insert: insert into play_attempt_log (member_id, topic_id, node_id, activity_id, attempt_type, result, wrong_answer, duration_s, result_json, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at) values (#{memberId}, #{topicId}, #{nodeId}, #{activityId}, #{attemptType}, #{result}, #{wrongAnswer}, #{durationS}, #{resultJson}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, member_id, topic_id, node_id, activity_id, attempt_type, result, wrong_answer, duration_s, result_json, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at from play_attempt_log where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select id, member_id, topic_id, node_id, activity_id, attempt_type, result, wrong_answer, duration_s, result_json, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at from play_attempt_log where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1 for update

select id, member_id, topic_id, node_id, activity_id, attempt_type, result, wrong_answer, duration_s, result_json, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at from play_attempt_log where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and attempt_type = 6 and result = 1 order by created_at, id
